item.title: Bullet Journal (BuJo)
item.description:
Summary

The Bullet Journal (BuJo) is an analog productivity system created by Ryder Carroll. It combines task management, journaling, planning, and note-taking in a minimal, customizable format using pen and paper — or digital equivalents like Markdown.

item.title: Rapid Logging
item.description:
Summary

Rapid Logging is a fast, structured method for capturing notes, tasks, and events using a system of bullets and symbols. It was popularized by the Bullet Journal method developed by Ryder Carroll.
